title: Listen and Choose a Response — Coursework

questions.stem: Isn't the lab report due this Friday?

options.A: I reported it to the office.
options.B: Yes, and it's due next Wednesday.
options.C: The lab is on the second floor.
options.D: It was, but the professor moved it to Monday.

questions.explanation: This explains a change to the due date. 'Yes' with a different day contradicts itself, and the others reuse 'report' and 'lab'.
questions.speaker: f3
